data.name: Claude Opus 5.5
data.description: Claude Opus 5.5 is a step-change improvement over Opus 5 for agentic coding, long-running agentic tasks, knowledge work, communication, and vision. It is more token-efficient per completed task and reports progress, findings, and next steps in clear language.

data.name: Claude Sonnet 4.5
data.description: Claude Sonnet 4.5 is the newest model in the Sonnet series, offering improvements and updates over Sonnet 4.

data.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
data.description: Claude Haiku 5.5 brings adaptive reasoning to Anthropic’s low-cost Haiku family for everyday tasks, tool use, and scaled sub-agent deployments. It is the first Haiku with adjustable effort levels, letting developers balance reasoning depth and token usage for each task, with the option to turn thinking off for simpler requests.

data.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
data.description: GPT-6.1 Sol is OpenAI's reasoning model for complex coding, computer use, and professional work. It accepts text and images, generates text, and supports a 1,050,000-token context window with up to 128,000 output tokens. Configurable reasoning effort, structured outputs, prompt caching, and Responses API tools support multi-step workflows.

data.name: GPT OSS 120B
data.description: Extremely capable general-purpose LLM with strong, controllable reasoning capabilities

data.name: Gemini 4 Argon
data.description: Gemini 4 Argon is Google’s multimodal reasoning model, supporting text, image, and file inputs with configurable reasoning levels. It combines tool calling, structured outputs, and Google Search and Maps grounding to support document analysis and agent workflows. Long-form generation supports continuation across requests, allowing applications to resume output beyond a single request’s token limit.

data.name: Grok 4.7
data.description: Grok 4.7 is SpaceXAI’s advanced AI model for coding and professional knowledge work, built to tackle complex, multi-hour tasks with improved self-verification and long-context handling. It strengthens software engineering, document creation, and presentation workflows while maintaining Grok 4.6’s speed and pricing.

data.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
data.description: Kimi K3.1 Pro is a frontier model from Moonshot AI for complex reasoning, coding, and agentic workflows, with support for vision, tool use, structured outputs, and long-context tasks.
